title: Count Dominant Nodes in a Binary Tree
summary: Given a complete binary tree, count the nodes whose value equals the maximum value in their respective subtree.
statement: Given a complete binary tree, count the nodes whose value equals the maximum value in their respective subtree.
constraints: A node is dominant when its value equals the maximum value in its entire rooted subtree.
The binary tree is complete but values may repeat.
Return the number of dominant nodes.

Compare the current value with both returned maxima.
